Remaining toys at 10% loss

CP of each toy = P

questions.question: If the compound interest on a certain sum of money for two years at 9% p.a. is Rs. 3,762, then the sum is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Compound Interest rate for 2 years = R + R + (R × R) ÷ 100.

Effective rate for 9% = 9 + 9 + (81 ÷ 100) = 18.81%.

Let the principal sum be P.

⇒ 18.81% of P = 3762

⇒ P = 3762 × (100 ÷ 18.81) = 20000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 20,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rate of interest (R) = 9% p.a.

Time (n) = 2 years

Compound Interest (CI) = Rs. 3,762

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1eb8888856736926e9059c29f7ea64361c5a0fe08459ff97a1d293c3a563fa77.png] 

**Formula Used:**

CI = P × [(1 + R ÷ 100)ⁿ − 1]

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3762 = P × [(1 + 9 ÷ 100)² − 1]

⇒ 3762 = P × [(109 ÷ 100)² − 1]

⇒ 3762 = P × [11881 ÷ 10000 − 1]

⇒ 3762 = P × [(11881 − 10000) ÷ 10000]

⇒ 3762 = P × [1881 ÷ 10000]

⇒ P = (3762 × 10000) ÷ 1881

⇒ P = 2 × 10000 = 20000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 20,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Compound Interest

For 2 years at R% per annum, the effective compound interest rate is calculated using the formula: R + R + (R² ÷ 100)%. This helps in quickly calculating the CI without deriving the total amount first.

Difference Between CI and SI for 2 Years

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on a principal P at rate R% for exactly 2 years is given directly by the formula: Difference = P × (R ÷ 100)².

Amount in Compound Interest

The total amount A after n years at compound interest is calculated using A = P(1 + R ÷ 100)ⁿ. The interest is then simply found by subtracting the original principal from the final amount.
</p

questions.question: A can do (2)/(5) of a work in 6 days and B can do 30% of the same work in 3 days. They worked together for 4 days. The remaining work was completed by C alone in 6 days. B and C together can complete 70% of the original work in :
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time: A = 15 days, B = 10 days. Total work = LCM(15, 10) = 30 units.

Efficiencies: A = 2, B = 3. Together they did (2 + 3) × 4 = 20 units in 4 days.

Remaining work = 30 − 20 = 10 units, completed by C in 6 days → C's efficiency = 10 ÷ 6 = 5/3 units/day.

Target work = 70% of 30 = 21 units. Combined efficiency of B and C = 3 + 5/3 = 14/3 units/day.

Time taken by (B + C) = 21 ÷ (14/3) = (21 × 3) ÷ 14 = 4½ days.

**∴ The correct answer is 4½ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A's time for complete work = 6 × (5/2) = 15 days

B's time for complete work = 3 × (100/30) = 10 days

Let Total Work = LCM(15, 10) = 30 units.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A
 15
 30
 30 ÷ 15 = 2
 
 

 B
 10
 30 ÷ 10 = 3
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Work done by (A + B) in 4 days = (2 + 3) × 4 = 20 units

⇒ Remaining work = 30 − 20 = 10 units

⇒ C completes 10 units in 6 days → Efficiency of C = 10 ÷ 6 = 5/3 units/day

⇒ Target work = 70% of 30 units = (70 ÷ 100) × 30 = 21 units

⇒ Combined efficiency of (B + C) = 3 + (5/3) = 14/3 units/day

⇒ Time taken by (B + C) = Target work ÷ Combined Efficiency

⇒ Time taken = 21 ÷ (14/3) = (21 × 3) ÷ 14 = 9/2 = 4½ days

**∴ The correct answer is 4½ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Work and Efficiency

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time. Total Work = Efficiency × Time Taken.

Pipes and Cisterns Concept

Works similarly to Time and Work, but involves negative efficiency for emptying pipes which drain the total volume.

Wages and Work

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the total work done by each individual, not strictly by their time taken or days spent.

questions.question: After giving a discount of 20% on the marked price of an article, it is sold for Rs. 120. Had the discount not been given, the profit would have been 20%. What is the cost price of the article?
questions.solution:
Given:

After giving a discount of 20% on MP, SP = Rs. 120

If the discount has not been given, Profit = 20%.

Concept used:

SP = MP - MP × Discount %

SP = CP + CP × Gain%

Calculation:

Let, MP of the article = Q, and CP of the article = P

According to the question,

⇒ Q - Q × 20% = 120

⇒ Q - 0.2Q = 120

⇒ 0.8Q = 120

⇒ Q = 120/0.8

⇒ Q = 150

Now,

⇒ P + P × 20% = 150

⇒ P + 0.2P = 150

⇒ 1.2P = 150

⇒ P = 150/1.2

⇒ P = 125

∴ The cost price of the article is Rs. 125. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let, original MP = X

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61723ee50cb80925821208b87b1664955ac327ee0ceb2dd1079b68b87555d2bf.png] 

X = 100 × 120/80 = 150

Let, original CP = Y

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73e78f079224f206c7561be52c0377fa66ab110a158f17053da0458d37f4e8bd.png] 

So, Y = 100 × 150/120 = Rs. 125

∴ The cost price of the article is Rs. 125.

questions.question: The greatest number that on dividing 2675 and 2320 leaves the remainder 5 and 6 , respectively is :
questions.solution:

questions.question: The ratio of two numbers is 9 : 5. If 8 is added to the larger number and 4 is subtracted from the smaller number, the greater number becomes twice the smaller number. The larger number is:

Calculation:

⇒ 9H + 8 = 10H - 8

⇒ 10H - 9H = 8 + 8

⇒ H = 16

Now, the larger number

⇒ 16 × 9 = 144

**∴ The larger number is 144.**

questions.question: The ratio of the ages of A, B and C, 5 years ago, was 4 : 5 : 7. The sum of their present ages is 135 years. What will be the sum of the ages (in years) of B and C, 3 years from now?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of ages of A, B, and C 5 years ago = Present sum − (3 persons × 5 years) = 135 − 15 = 120.

Total ratio parts 5 years ago = 4 + 5 + 7 = 16 parts.

Value of 1 ratio part = 120 ÷ 16 = 7.5 years.

Sum of ages of B and C 5 years ago = (5 + 7) parts = 12 × 7.5 = 90 years.

Sum of B and C 3 years from now = Sum 5 years ago + (5 years + 3 years) × 2 persons = 90 + 16 = 106 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 106 years.**

questions.question: If the sides of the triangle measure 21 cm, 35 cm, and 28 cm. What is the measure of its in radius? (in cm)
questions.solution:
Given:

The sides of the triangle are 21 cm, 35 cm and 28 cm.

Concept used:

Semi-permieter of a triangle, S = (A + B + C)/2

Area of a triangle

⇒ sqrt {S (S - A) (S - B) (S - C)}

Where, A,B,C are the length of three sides of the triangle.

The measure of the inradius of a triangle

⇒ {Area of the triangle} over {Semi perimeter of the triangle}

Calculation:

Semi-permieter of the triangular park

⇒ (21 + 35 + 28)/2

⇒ 84/2 = 42 m

Area of the triangular park

⇒ sqrt {42 (42 - 21) (42 - 35) (42- 28)}

⇒ sqrt {42 × 21 × 7 × 14}

⇒ sqrt { 7 × 3 × 2 × 7 × 3 × 7 × 7 × 2}

⇒ 7 × 7 × 3 × 2

⇒ 294 cm²

Now, the inradius of the triangle

⇒ 294/42 = 7 cm

∴ The measure of the inradius is 7 cm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Pythagoras Theorem states that "In a right-angled triangle. the square of the hypotenuse side is equal to the sum of squares of the other two sides."

questions.question: The amount of certain sum in 3 years at simple interest at x% p.a is Rs. 5,472 and the amount of the same sum is 7(1)/(2) years at the same rate, at simple interest is Rs. 6,930. the value of x is:
questions.solution:
Given:

A sum in 3 years at simple interest at x% p.a is Rs. 5,472.

The same sum in 7(1)/(2) i.e., 7.5 years at x% p.a. at simple interest is Rs. 6,930.

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

Where, P = Principal amount, R = Rate of interest per year, 

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the sum be Rs. p.

According to the question,

p + (p × x × 3)/100 = 5472 ....(1)

According to the question,

p + (p × x × 7.5)/100 = 6930 ....(2)

Subtracting equation (1) from equation (2),

p + (p × x × 7.5)/100 - p - (p × x × 3)/100 = 6930 - 5472

⇒ 7.5xp/100 - 3xp/100 = 1458

⇒ 4.5xp/100 = 1458

⇒ xp = 145800/4.5

⇒ xp = 32400 ....(3)

Putting xp = 32400 in (2),

p + (p × x × 7.5)/100 = 6930

⇒ p + (32400 × 7.5)/100 = 6930

⇒ p = 6930 - (32400 × 7.5)/100

⇒ p = 6930 - 2430

⇒ p = 4500 ....(4)

Putting p = 4500 in (3),

x × 4500 = 32400

⇒ x = 32400/4500

⇒ x = 7.2

∴ The value of x is 7.2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

When 'rate of interest' is uniform and time varies then-

R = large{((A₁ - A₂)/(A₂× T₁ - A₁× T₂))× 100}

Where, A₁ = First amount, A₂ = Second amount

T₁ = first time, T₂ = Second time, R = Rate of interest

∴ According to the question -

R = [(5472 - 6930)/(6930 × 3 - 5472 × 7.5)] × 100

R = [(-1458)/(20790 - 41040)] × 100

R = (1458/20250) × 100

R = 7.2%

∴ **Required rate of interest is 7.2% **

questions.question: A dealer sold an article at a loss of 4%. Had he sold it for Rs. 120 more, he would have gained 8%. To gain 11% he should sell the article for?
questions.solution:
Given:

A dealer sold an article at a loss of 4%. 

If it is sold for Rs. 120 more, he would have gained 8%. 

Concept used:

SP = CP - CP × Loss%

SP = CP + CP × Gain%

Calculation:

Let the cost price be Q.

So, the selling price of the article

⇒ Q - Q × 4%

⇒ Q - Q × 0.04

⇒ 0.96Q

According to the question,

Q + Q × 8% = 0.96Q + 120

⇒ Q + Q × 0.08 = 0.96Q + 120

⇒ 1.08Q = 0.96Q + 120

⇒ 1.08Q - 0.96Q = 120

⇒ 0.12Q = 120

⇒ Q = 120/0.12

⇒ Q = 1000

Now, to gain 11% he should sell the article for 

⇒ 1000 + 1000 × 11%

⇒ 1000 + 110

⇒ Rs. 1110

**∴ To gain 11% he should sell the article for Rs. 1,110.**

questions.question: A and B can complete a piece of work in 120 days. B and C can complete it in 150 days, and A and C can complete it in 200 days. In how many days can B alone complete two-fifths of the same work?
questions.solution:
Given: 

A and B can complete a work in 120 days. 

B and C can complete it in 150 days.

A and C can complete it in 200 days.

Concept used:

Total work = Work done per day × Total time taken 

Calculation:

LCM (120, 150, 200) = 600 units

Let, Total work = LCM of the time taken by different workers

The efficiencies of A, B, and C be denoted by a, b, and c.

So, Total work = 600 units

Let the efficiencies of A, B, and C be denoted by A, B, and C.

According to the question,

a + b = 600/120

⇒ a + b = 5 ---(1)

b + c = 600/150

⇒ b + c = 4 ---(2)

a + c = 600/200

⇒ a + c = 3 ---(3)

Equation (1) + Equation (2) + Equation (3),

⇒ a + b + b + c + a + c = 5 + 4 + 3

⇒ 2(a + b + c) = 12

⇒ (a + b + c) = 12/2

⇒ (a + b + c) = 6 ---(4)

Subtracting equation (4) from equation (3),

(a + b + c) - (a + c) = 6 - 3

⇒ a + b + c - a - c = 3

⇒ b = 3

Now, the time taken by B to complete 2/5th of the work

⇒ {(2/5) × 600}/3

⇒ {1200/5}/3

⇒ 240/3 = 80 days

**∴ In 80 days B can alone complete two-fifths of the work.**
